decisions.reason: As a new product that builds directly on our established spraying systems, it has not had enough time to prove itself below our aspiration level and the growing market plus our customization capabilities justify carrying this niche offer a bit longer.

Because this pump is very close to our core business and was given a dedicated market presentation, it likely meets at least provisional aspiration levels and fits efficient use of our existing engineering and production resources.

Although early evidence is limited, this transfer pump extends our established material-handling range with low additional organizational strain, so with available innovative capacity we would keep it while learning from the market.

This monitoring product supports our strategic move toward more digital and interoperable customer solutions, and without clear signs of underperformance we would retain it under the firm’s current slack and growth conditions.
